releaseNotes: More Workbook Audit findings can now be repaired directly: date-as-text conversion, dominant number-format apply, merge unmerge and duplicate-row delete - each with preview, verification and Undo.
Formula repairs now show the exact result the restored formula will produce before you confirm.
Conflicting repairs on the same cell are identified before any change - Workbook Audit asks you to choose one instead of applying both.
Circular references open a member-by-member cycle view, and formula errors can trace their precedents and dependents on the sheet.
External workbook findings now offer guided relink (with backup and undo) and break-to-cached-values where the evidence supports them, with clear explanations when they do not.
Sensitive-text findings offer an explicit, confirmed Clear Cell action with Undo; identifier-like numeric text stays protected from automatic conversion, with a clear reason.
Number-format inconsistencies are now detected reliably on real workbooks.
